moveLogRevisions.whatChanged: Consensus moved +12.6 pts in 18 minutes after the 14:30 CPI release. The 2s/CAD complex led; housing did not follow.
unexplainedFactors: Canadian housing did not reprice with the rate shock
Residual 36% of the move is not identified; part of the 2Y reaction coincided with a U.S. Treasury block
